text: Manzanilla from Jerez? No such thing.
It starts with albariza: chalk soil that holds water, even in summer.
It lies between Jerez, Sanlúcar and El Puerto.
From the west blows the poniente, cool and damp, off the ocean.
Damp air feeds the flor: the yeast on fino and manzanilla.
In Sanlúcar, at the river mouth, that layer stays thick all year.
From the east comes the levante: hot and dry.
